title: A trace-normalized tensor counit respects the coefficient action
statement: Let C and D be monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category], F:C→D a strong monoidal functor [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], G:D→C a functor, and p(K,M):K⊗G(M)→G(F(K)⊗M) a natural invertible projection action satisfying its coefficient associativity equation. If W is in D, b:G(W)→1, and c(K):G(F(K)⊗W)→K satisfy p(K,W);c(K)=(K⊗b);ρ(K) for every K, then p(H,F(B)⊗W);G(α⁻¹;(μ(H,B)⊗1));c(H⊗B)=H⊗c(B) for all H,B. All compositions and constraints are the displayed ones, with no adjunction hypothesis.

source.place: last paragraph: projection formula on chosen compactifications and the ordered affine-line tower; categorical calculations making coefficient normalization explicit

proof.text:
precompose by the invertible map `H tensor p B W`. The action equation
replaces the two projections by the projection for `H tensor B` and its
associator. The inverse associator and inverse tensorator then cancel. Apply
normalization at `H tensor B` and at `B`. Naturality of the associator moves
the trace to the last factor, and the right-unitor coherence finishes.

theorem normalizedTensorCounit_action
    {C D : Type*} [Category* C] [Category* D]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Monoidal] (G : D ⥤ C)
    (p : ∀ (K : C) (M : D), K ⊗ G.obj M ⟶ G.obj (F.obj K ⊗ M))
    [∀ K M, IsIso (p K M)]
    (hp : ∀ (H B : C) (M : D),
      p (H ⊗ B) M ≫ G.map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F H B ▷ M ≫
        (α_ (F.obj H) (F.obj B) M).hom) =
      (α_ H B (G.obj M)).hom ≫ H ◁ p B M ≫ p H (F.obj B ⊗ M))
    (W : D) (b : G.obj W ⟶ 𝟙_ C)
    (c : ∀ K : C, G.obj (F.obj K ⊗ W) ⟶ K)
    (hc : ∀ K : C, p K W ≫ c K = K ◁ b ≫ (ρ_ K).hom)
    (H B : C) :
    p H (F.obj B ⊗ W) ≫
      G.map ((α_ (F.obj H) (F.obj B) W).inv ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F H B ▷ W) ≫ c (H ⊗ B) = H ◁ c B
